subject: OmniPay compliance recap + DPA & pen-test artifact plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Tanner <ltanner@omnipay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: OmniPay call recap — SOC 2, retention & DPA next steps

Hi Lucas —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have a shared checklist to move toward procurement: 

Key pain points you shared
- Regulatory: OmniPay needs strict retention controls and demonstrable audit logs for card-processing flows (6+ years in your EU merchants).
- Evidence: Your security team needs SOC 2 artifacts + an up-to-date penetration test report before final sign-off.
- Data residency & DPA: Concern about where logs are stored and what our DPA looks like for subprocessor disclosures.

Goals we agreed on
- Provide a scoped artifact bundle (SOC 2 summary, log retention matrix, pen test summary) by EOW to satisfy initial security review.
- Clarify retention and export controls for audit logs in our Private/VPC option (possible on-prem SKU discussion later).
- Deliver a redline-ready DPA template and a short SSO/KMS architecture note for legal.

Action items (owner / target)
1) Redwood: Share SOC 2 summary + retention matrix + pen-test executive summary (Neha) — target: Tue 5/31 EOB.
2) OmniPay: Confirm whether the retention requirement applies to PCI-scope logs only or both PCI- and non-PCI flows (Lucas) — target: Wed 6/2.
3) Redwood legal & engineering: Draft DPA redline and KMS/SSO diagram (Marissa + Jordan) — target: Fri 6/4.

Attachments I will include in my next email: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, retention-matrix.csv, pen-test-summary-2026.pdf.

If that aligns, I’ll send the artifact bundle and a short cover note for your security reviewers.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

---
Note: Files attached will be watermarked and include an evidence index.
From: Lucas Tanner <ltanner@omnipay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@omnipay.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmniPay call recap — SOC 2, retention & DPA next steps

Neha —

Thanks for the clear summary. That maps well to what I need to get internal buy-in. A couple clarifications from my side: 

- Retention: This applies to both PCI and non-PCI telemetry for our EU merchant subset. We need a retention policy that can be scoped by customer and by region.
- Pen test: We require either a third-party report or an executive summary showing remediation status for any critical/high findings. The full report can be shared under NDA.
- DPA: Our legal team will want a subprocessors appendix and a clause about forensic access for regulated audits. I’ve looped our legal mailbox above — they’ll review the DPA redline.

I’ll confirm the final list of reviewers tomorrow and can share an internal ticket number for audit intake.

—Lucas
Lucas Tanner
Head of Security Operations
OmniPay
ltanner@omnipay.com
+1 (212) 555-0984

Subject: Fwd: OmniPay call recap — inventory & artifact packaging suggestion

Neha / Jordan —

Forwarding Lucas’s reply. A couple of internal notes before we send the artifact package: 

1) Artifact packaging: I suggest we provide two bundles: (A) a public SOC 2 summary + FAQ + retention matrix and (B) an NDA-gated full pen-test report and evidence index. Keeps things fast for initial review while protecting sensitive docs.
2) Retention matrix: Jordan — can you confirm whether our current Private/VPC controls support per-customer retention policies for log exports? If not, a clear mitigation note and timeline would help.
3) DPA appendix: I’ll draft a subprocessors appendix template (standard Redwood language) and flag any clauses likely to be redlined by gateways (e.g., forensic access, export controls).

I’m attaching a short internal checklist to speed the handoff to engineering and legal.

Attachments: internal-evidence-checklist.txt (internal), draft-dpa-appendix.docx (internal)

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security & Trust

Subject: OmniPay artifact bundle & next steps (DPA redline request)

Lucas / OmniPay legal —

Per our call and Marissa’s notes, attached is the initial artifact bundle intended for your security team's intake: 
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (public summary of scope and controls)
- retention-matrix.csv (shows which log types we can retain/export and retention-by-region)
- pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (executive summary; full PDF available under NDA)

A few immediate notes: 
- The retention matrix shows a per-customer retention toggle for audit logs in our Private deployment; for Hosted we provide region-level retention and export tools.
- The pen-test summary lists no unresolved critical issues; there are two medium findings with remediation scheduled in Q3 2026. Full report available under NDA.
- Draft DPA appendix (internal) will follow from Marissa and Jordan — if your legal team can send a redline to legal@omnipay.com we’ll prioritize review.

Next steps / calendar
- Neha: Share HubSpot deal link and request audit intake ticket (done) — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/rdw-4821
- OmniPay: Confirm reviewers + whether full pen test report is required pre-purchase (Lucas/legal) — target: 6/2
- Redwood legal & engineering: Deliver draft DPA appendix + KMS/SSO one-pager (Marissa/Jordan) — target: 6/4

If helpful, we can schedule a follow-up 30-minute readout for your security reviewers next week. What days/times work for Lucas and legal?

Thanks all —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
